'''''Hieracium lachenalii''''', or '''common hawkweed''', is a species of plant in the tribe [[Cichorieae]] within the family [[Asteraceae]]. It is native to Europe but has become established as a weed in Australia and parts of North America.

== Taxonomy ==
The species was widely known for many years as ''H. vulgatum'',<ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=250066961 Flora of North America, ''Hieracium vulgatum'' Fries, 1819. ]</ref> but more recent studies have indicated that the two names represent the same species. The name ''H. lachenalii'' was coined in 1802,<ref>[http://www.ipni.org/ipni/idPlantNameSearch.do?id=327414-2&back_page=%2Fipni%2FeditAdvPlantNameSearch.do%3Ffind_infragenus%3D%26find_geoUnit%3D%26find_includePublicationAuthors%3Dtrue%26find_addedSince%3D%26find_family%3D%26find_genus%3DHieracium%26find_infrafamily%3D%26find_rankToReturn%3Dspec%26find_publicationTitle%3D%26find_authorAbbrev%3D%26find_infraspecies%3D%26find_includeBasionymAuthors%3Dtrue%26find_modifiedSince%3D%26find_species%3Dlachenalii%26output_format%3Dnormal The International Plant Names Index, ''Hieracium lachenalii'' ]</ref> and ''H. vulgatum'' in 1819,<ref>[http://www.ipni.org/ipni/idPlantNameSearch.do?id=327415-2&back_page=%2Fipni%2FeditAdvPlantNameSearch.do%3Ffind_infragenus%3D%26find_geoUnit%3D%26find_includePublicationAuthors%3Dtrue%26find_addedSince%3D%26find_family%3D%26find_genus%3DHieracium%26find_infrafamily%3D%26find_rankToReturn%3Dspec%26find_publicationTitle%3D%26find_authorAbbrev%3D%26find_infraspecies%3D%26find_includeBasionymAuthors%3Dtrue%26find_modifiedSince%3D%26find_species%3Dvulgatum%26output_format%3Dnormal The International Plant Names Index, ''Hieracium vulgatum'' ]</ref> so per taxonomic regulations, the older name is to be used, with ''H. vulgatum'' delegated to being a [[Synonym (taxonomy)|synonym]].<ref>
[https://www.iapt-taxon.org/nomen/main.php?page=art11 International Code of Nomenclature for algae, fungi, and plants (Melbourne Code), article 11]</ref>

==Description==
This common weed can grow and produce flowers on plants that range from {{convert|4|in|cm|abbr=off|sp=us}} to {{convert|36|in|cm}}  tall. The [[rhizome]] is short and stout. The broadly [[Elliptic leaf|elliptic]] leaves can be up to {{convert|5|in|cm|abbr=off|sp=us}} long and [[:wiktionary:taper#Adjective|taper]] with teeth towards the base.<ref name="msuplants">{{cite web|url=http://msuplants.com/pd.asp?pid=3104
|archive-url=https://archive.today/20080229223825/http://msuplants.com/pd.asp?pid=3104
|archive-date=2008-02-29
|title=MSUplants.com Hieracium lachenalii|access-date=2007-12-14|author=MSU Board of Trustees|author2=Jesse L Saylor|author3=Network Vista, Inc.|name-list-style=amp |work=msuplants.com/index.html|publisher=Michigan State University Department of Horticulture }}</ref> Each flower head has 40-80 [[ray florets]] but no [[disc floret]]s.<ref name='INS'>{{cite web |url=http://www.dpi.vic.gov.au/DPI/nreninf.nsf/childdocs/-9B2A7AB4FD562D03CA256BC800058E91-FAE39D5678422E99CA256BC800062A59-663C5274163D2336CA256E8D001EFC6C-A348BEAAE2BC7393CA256D4A000C59A3?open|title=Hawkweeds: State Prohibited Weed |access-date=2007-12-14|author=Ian Faithfull|work=Information Notes Series |publisher=Department of Primary Industries, Victoria, Australia|date=2007-09-19}}</ref><ref name='grieve'>{{cite web|url=https://www.botanical.com/botanical/mgmh/h/hawwee07.html |title=Hawkweed, Wood|access-date=2007-12-14|author=Mrs. M. Grieve|author-link=Maud Grieve|year=1933|work=A Modern Herbal|publisher=Botanical.com}}
</ref> [[Bract]]s surround the [[flower head]]; the receptacle ([[Basal (anatomy)|basal]] part of the flower on which the florets are attached) is flat and naked; heads tend to start together then become somewhat solitary on long leafless stems.<ref name='INS'/>
The stalks below the heads are covered with scattered, simple and gland-tipped black hairs and contain a milky substance.<ref name='grieve'/>

The pale [[yellow]] flowers are produced during all of the [[summer]] [[month]]s. The fruit are dark brown [[achenes]].<ref name="msuplants"/>

==Distribution and habitat==
Native to most of Europe,<ref name='EuroPlusMed'>{{cite web|url=http://ww2.bgbm.org/EuroPlusMed/PTaxonDetail.asp?NameCache&61%3BHieracium&32%3Blachenalii&PTRefFk&61%3B7000000|title=Details for: Hieracium lachenalii|access-date=2007-12-14|author1=Botanic Garden|author2=Botanical Museum Berlin-Dahlem|author-link=Botanical Garden in Berlin|date=June 5, 2007|work=The Euro+Med Plantbase|publisher=Botanic Garden and Botanical Museum Berlin-Dahlem}}{{Dead link|date=July 2018 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> ''Hieracium lachenalii'' was introduced to temperate parts of North America,<ref>[https://bonap.net/MapGallery/State/Hieracium%20lachenalii.png Biota of North America Program 2014 state-level distribution map]</ref> and to Australia.<ref name='INS'/> It can sometimes be found in soils that have been disturbed.<ref name='gresham'>{{cite web|url= http://ghs.gresham.k12.or.us/science/ps/nature/gorge/sun/dandy/hieracium/hieracvulgatum.htm|title=Common Hawkweed|access-date=2007-12-21|author=Paul Slichter|work=Wildflowers of the Genus Hieracium:Hawkweeds of the Columbia River Gorge|quote=Common hawkweed may be found in disturbed soils. |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040122054644/http://ghs.gresham.k12.or.us/science/ps/nature/gorge/sun/dandy/hieracium/hieracvulgatum.htm |archive-date=2004-01-22 }}</ref>

===Europe===
In Europe, the species is found in [[Austria]], [[Belarus]], [[Belgium]], [[Bosnia-Herzegovina]], [[Croatia]], [[Corsica]], the [[Czech Republic]], [[Denmark]], [[Estonia]], [[France]], [[Finland]], [[Germany]], [[Hungary]], [[Ireland]], [[Italy]], [[Latvia]],[[Liechtenstein]], [[Lithuania]], [[Luxembourg|Luxemburg]], [[Montenegro]], [[Netherlands]], [[North Macedonia]], [[Norway]], [[Poland]], [[Portugal]], [[Romania]], [[San Marino]], [[Serbia]], [[Slovenia]], [[Slovakia]], [[Sweden]], [[Switzerland]], [[Ukraine]], the [[United Kingdom]], and [[Russia]].
===North America===
'''Subarctic America:''' [[Greenland]].<ref name='GRIN'>{{GRIN | access-date=2007-12-14}}</ref>

'''Canada:''' Provinces of [[British Columbia]], [[New Brunswick]], [[Newfoundland (island)|Newfoundland]], [[Nova Scotia]], [[Ontario]], [[Prince Edward Island]], and [[Quebec]].<ref name='GRIN'/>

'''United States:''' States of [[Connecticut]], [[Delaware]], [[Maine]], [[Massachusetts]], [[Michigan]], [[Minnesota]], [[New Hampshire]], [[New Jersey]], [[New York (state)|New York]], [[Oregon]], [[Pennsylvania]], [[Rhode Island]], [[Vermont]], [[Washington (U.S. state)|Washington]], and [[Wisconsin]].<ref name='GRIN'/>
